Ensure tickets are appropriately categorized, prioritized, assigned, and routed according to defined support processes and service workflows. Conduct trend analysis to identify recurring incidents, service disruptions, and process improvement opportunities. Support management reviews through detailed reporting and service insights. Assist in testing and deployment of new ServiceDesk Plus enhancements and upgrades. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement Develop operational dashboards and executive reports using Excel, Power BI, and ServiceDesk Plus reporting capabilities. Analyze ticket trends, service performance, workload patterns, and customer experience metrics. Identify recurring issues and support Problem Management initiatives. Recommend service improvements, process enhancements, and automation opportunities. Support knowledge management initiatives designed to improve First Contact Resolution and reduce ticket volumes. Contribute to Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) programs and operational transformation initiatives. ITIL Process Compliance Ensure adherence to ITIL best practices and organizational ITSM governance standards. Support Incident, Request, Problem, Knowledge, and Change Management processes. Maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, workflow guides, and operational runbooks. Participate in process audits, reviews, and compliance assessments. Assist management in implementing operational dashboards and governance mechanisms. Required Technical Skills ITSM Platforms ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus ServiceDesk Plus Administration ITSM Ticket Lifecycle Management Workflow Design & Automation Queue Management ITIL Process Expertise Incident Management Service Request Management Problem Management Knowledge Management Major Incident Management Escalation Management SLA Management Reporting & Analytics Service Desk KPI Reporting Operational Dashboard Development Service Desk Analytics Trend Analysis Microsoft Excel (Advanced) Power BI Operational Governance Ticket Quality Assurance Queue Governance Service Reviews Process Compliance Continuous Service Improvement What You’ll Need To Succeed (required Skills) Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or equivalent experience. 5-8+ years of experience supporting enterprise Service Desk and ITSM operations. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience managing ticket queues in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus or a similar ITSM platform. Strong understanding of ITIL service management processes and operational governance. Experience working in managed services, outsourcing, public-sector, or large enterprise environments. Demonstrated experience managing SLA-driven support operations. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills. Preferred Skills Experience supporting public-sector or government clients. Experience in large-scale managed services environments supporting 5,000+ users.
